description: This file contains implementation of serialization and deserialization functions for various media sample info structures, including audio and video, with byte order handling, specific to the 'video_dmp' component in the 'starboard' media framework.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a callback into a buffer, with size validation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer to a callback, with size validation.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserializes media::AudioSampleInfo from a callback, handling byte order and skipping certain fields.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Serializes media::AudioStreamInfo into a callback, with dummy values for compatibility.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Deserializes media::VideoSampleInfo from a callback, including color metadata and mastering metadata.
